decision: Keep the existing safety engine as the floor runner and add a sealed profile-selecting front office, evidence office, and promotion desk.

implementation_update_2026_08_13.dispatch_contract: labctl seals one execution spec; front_office_dispatch invokes the profile-pinned floor runner with direct argv and shell=False; the floor runner revalidates and owns global port 8199, locks, queue, measurement, receipts, and cleanup.
implementation_update_2026_08_13.execution_lifecycle: single-use sealed spec, fresh cold server, mandatory terminal shutdown proof, no inherited warmth or promotion eligibility
implementation_update_2026_08_13.first_smoke: front-office-r1/t2i-low-smoke passed as a SaveImage plumbing check only; it does not claim video or audio media-gate coverage.
implementation_update_2026_08_13.current_h3_native_av_smoke: front-office-h3-current-r1/i2v-native-av-smoke is a sealed 3.750-second current-profile native-A/V cold cell; it is prepared but has not run.
implementation_update_2026_08_13.c032_status: BLOCKED: no separate local 0.31.1 worktree/profile and no warm-session protocol for a matched 0.31.1-versus-0.32.0 campaign.

why_now.finding: Zero promotion-ready aliases bind the active runner hash, and hard-coded ComfyUI/Python roots prevent a clean 0.31.1-versus-0.32.0 comparison. OTR production is Sage-free: profile launch.sage_attention is dead, unwired metadata and must not justify Runner Division architecture.

front_office_in_scope: enrolled profile IDs only; never arbitrary roots or inherited-environment selection
profile pins for Python executable, ComfyUI root/version/commit, custom-node whitelist/commits, model-paths config, and canonical argv
profile identity and launch-spec hash in every new receipt
per-cell output, result, and log namespaces
computed STALE_FOR_ACTIVE_RUNNER display classification without rewriting old receipt bytes
explicitly_deferred: receipt schema v4 full field set
active_mission_scope.h3_lip_txt_exception: H3-LIP-TXT is eligible on the current runner after its transcript-window receipt because prompt text is its only independent variable; H3-C032 remains gated on the minimal enrolled-profile front office.

tracked_dead_metadata.finding: No OTR launcher passes --use-sage-attention; production runs Sage-free. The separate assert_sage_not_patched runtime safeguard remains live.
